title: Tantra Vigyan Bhairav | 112 Guided Meditations by Shiva | Self-Realization | Non-Dual (Part 1)
author: tounknowndotcom
description: Enter the timeless wisdom of the Vigyan Bhairav Tantra — 112 guided meditation techniques spoken by Shiva to bring the seeker directly into the now. In this podcast, you’ll journey through these powerful techniques, split into 23 deep, immersive parts. Each meditation blends ancient knowledge with modern mindfulness — guided gently, clearly, and spiritually. 🌀 Perfect for yogis, meditators, and seekers on the path. By ToUnknown.com — your space for awakening through ancient teachings and conscious living. Remember, this is Part 1 of 23. Search the other parts to continue the practice 🙏
